goal: Expose each independent slow physical pilot and history-route case without changing execution budgets or authority checks.
procedure: Use completed job logs to distinguish a finished independent case from later coverage lost to the shared job cap. Retain the native pilot pass and cancellation receipt: f3c completed its first case in 1947.869 seconds and the job was cancelled before the remaining three cases completed. Assign the four exact native-pilot methods and two exact history-route methods to six separate shards, removing only their previous module-wide grouping. Reject new methods in either module until an exact case mapping is added. Reject missing configured cases and duplicate identities. Keep the other six groups, core restart probes, transport failure observer, ordinary integration command, sixty-minute caps and sixty-second paired budgets unchanged. Discover the actual integration suite without executing backends, verify all 43 distinct cases occur once and each new shard contains one exact method, and confirm matrix parity before publication.
authority: FloRA infrastructure procedure trace only. This records a CI partition change and grants no source permission, independent producer or model qualification, learned behavior, or supervised FBM target.
validation: Five focused partition regressions passed in 1.217 seconds. Actual import-only integration discovery found 43 distinct cases assigned exactly once across 12 physical shards: core28, transport2, native-comparison1, each of four native-pilot shards1, lineage2, readers2, history2, and each of two history-route shards1. Published prior partition grouped four native pilots and two history routes sequentially. New pilot/route methods, duplicate identities and missing configured cases are rejected before execution. Workflow matrix parity, both 60-minute job caps and the existing transport failure observer were checked. These are CI discovery mechanics; newly isolated physical case outcomes still require exact published CI receipts.
failure_or_lesson: A sequential integration job can consume its cap on one independent case and conceal later cases. Separate jobs expose those outcomes without extending response budgets or weakening authority gates.
notes: Isolated jobs still use actual selected-engine services and unchanged ordinary test bodies. Parallel independent infrastructure cases do not qualify models or paired response latency.
